correctness.rationale: With initial residual unit v, the first FGMRES LS step chooses α=(v·w)/||w||² for w=Az, ||v-w||≤µ, and residual q=v-αw=t u, t≤µ, u unit, v·u=t. Conversely every such pair u,v is realized by w=v-tu,z=A^-1w, so this constrained geometry is exact, not a relaxation. Errors are Bv and tBu for B=A^-1; compressing B² onto span{u,v} with SPD eigenvalue ratio≤κ reduces to the sharp norm ||diag(γ,1) R_t diag(γ^-1,1)||, γ≤κ. Its determinant is one, squared Frobenius norm 2+(γ-γ^-1)²(1-t²); the top singular value equals [√(4+δ²(1-t²))+δ√(1-t²)]/2 with δ=κ-κ^-1. Multiplying by t gives exact envelope gκ(t), achieved by two-dimensional right singular vector construction for arbitrary t. Optimizing over t≤µ yields t*=√[(4+δ²)/(4+2δ²)] and Gκ(µ)=gκ(min{µ,t*}); saturation (κ+κ^-1)/2. Solving gκ(t)=1 gives exact nonexpansion iff µ≤[1+δ²]^-1/2 for κ>1; for κ=1 G=µ. Independently constructed 2D SPD singular-vector witnesses for κ=1,2,10,100 across t=.05,.2,.7,.94 and matched computed LS error ratio to envelope including κ=10,µ=.2 giving≈1.9603998767. The determinant/singular-value proof, not finite tests, carries all dimensions.
